title: Attestation Origin Issuer
description: An attestation issuer identified by an HTTPS origin.

type.description: The issuer is identified by a canonical HTTPS origin because no AdCP brand or agent identity applies.

origin.description: Canonical HTTPS origin with no path, query, fragment, or userinfo. This identifies the issuer; it does not authorize a fetch. Receivers compare these values by canonical origin (docs/reference/url-canonicalization.mdx#canonical-origin), so `https://host` and `https://host/` name the same origin.
